extracted.name: Classic shandy
extracted.description: Customise this classic shandy with your choice of beer and let the lemonade bring that citrus zing. It's a great thirst-quencher on hot, balmy days
instruction_lines: Drop a lemon slice into a tall drinking glass. Pour over the beer and lemonade.
Stir well, then make a small cut in a second lemon slice and use this to garnish the rim of the glass.
